newsitem.title: USA: Fox wins Jan 26 weekly ratings - Nielsen.
newsitem.headline: Fox wins Jan 26 weekly ratings - Nielsen.

text.p: The Fox Channel, a unit of News Corp Ltd, had the highest rating with 14.5 percent of United States households with television sets in the week ending January 26, Nielsen Media Research said on Tuesday.
Fox drew the largest average evening-hours audience, earning 23 percent of the television sets in use during those hours.
The channel's success appeared to be largely due to its coverage of the Super Bowl football game last Sunday.
The number of U.S. households with television sets is calculated at 97 million.
NBC, a unit of General Electric Co, was second with 9.9 percent of households and 16 percent of the televisions and Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS came in third with 8.5 percent and 14 percent.

The other contenders were Walt Disney Co's ABC with 8.1 percent and 13 percent, WB of Time Warner Inc and Tribune Co had 2.3 percent and 4.0 percent, and UPN, a unit of Chris-Craft Industries Inc that is allied with Viacom Inc, had 3.0 percent and 5.0 percent.
